it could be your first name last name a bank credit card. Information

textual.potential_relevance: The claimed Apple identity and device-risk message are linked to a requested callback or keypad action and a request for personal or financial information, creating a concrete mechanism for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that a particular viewer received such a call, that the caller was actually unaffiliated with Apple, or that any information or money was obtained.
